# Maifa — Amaron Car Batteries Kenya
# https://maifa.ke
# Last updated: 2026-05-24

## About Maifa

Maifa is Kenya's trusted Amaron car battery specialist, founded in 2012. We supply and professionally fit Amaron batteries across Nairobi, Kiambu Road, and Mombasa. Every battery comes with a 12-month warranty claimable at any branch.

Core services:
- Supply and professional fitting of Amaron car batteries
- Same-day delivery and fitting for orders placed before 4pm in Nairobi
- 12-month warranty on all batteries (no paperwork, claimable in-branch)
- Free battery testing for walk-in customers
- Honest, transparent pricing — no hidden fitting fees

Battery ranges stocked:
- Amaron Hi Life (standard lead-acid, Japanese-import optimised)
- Amaron Black (maintenance-free, heavy-duty)
- EFB (Enhanced Flooded Battery, for start-stop vehicles)
- AGM (Absorbent Glass Mat, premium European vehicles)
- European DIN range (for newer Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes, etc.)

## How to Order

1. Find your battery on https://maifa.ke/shop (search by car make/model or battery size)
2. Click "Order Now" on any product page
3. Enter your name, phone, and location — then choose WhatsApp or online order
4. Our team calls you to confirm and arrange delivery/fitting

No advance payment required. Payment on delivery.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do I know which battery fits my car?**
A: Use the battery finder on our home page (search by make, model, year) or WhatsApp us at +254 791 899 602.

**Q: Do you offer same-day delivery?**
A: Yes — order before 4pm and we'll fit it the same day across Nairobi.

**Q: How does the warranty work?**
A: All batteries come with a 12-month warranty. Walk into any Maifa branch, and we'll resolve your claim in minutes — no forms, no waiting.

**Q: Do you fit the battery at my location?**
A: Yes. We deliver and fit at your home, office, or roadside across Nairobi. Mombasa fitting is also available.

**Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
A: M-Pesa, cash, and card (at branch). Payment is on delivery.
